recognize_zh: 低細胞量骨髓 CD34（紅色色原）染色只見零星散在的單顆陽性細胞，部分呈線狀為血管內皮，沒有 CD34 陽性細胞成簇聚集，估計母細胞少於 5%，不支持母細胞增加。
features: Hypocellular fatty marrow with thin interstitial hematopoietic cords
Rare scattered single CD34-positive mononuclear cells with membranous staining
Some linear CD34 staining of capillary endothelium (internal positive control)
No clusters or aggregates of CD34-positive blasts
Estimated CD34-positive hematopoietic cells well below 5% of cellularity
describe_en: CD34 immunostain on a hypocellular bone marrow biopsy shows only rare, scattered single positive mononuclear cells, with additional linear staining of capillary endothelium serving as an internal control. No clusters or aggregates of CD34-positive cells are identified, and positive hematopoietic cells account for less than 5% of the cellularity. There is no evidence of increased blasts. In the context of a hypocellular marrow with dysplasia, findings support refractory cytopenia of childhood rather than MDS with increased blasts.

ddx.vs: It shows 2-19% blasts in the marrow or blood, often with CD34-positive clusters on biopsy.
CD34 cells are also reduced, so distinction relies on dysplasia, megakaryocyte morphology, and clonal cytogenetics.
Hypocellular AML shows at least 20% blasts with sheets or clusters of CD34-positive cells.
